context.industry_setting: cross-industry (U.S.-listed firms, excluding financial and utilities sectors; acquisition targets concentrated in innovative FF-48 industries: business services, electronic equipment, medical equipment, computers, pharmaceutical products)
context.sample_description: Acquisitions of listed bidders and targets from the Thomson SDC M&A database (mergers or acquisitions of majority interests), excluding targets and acquirers from the financial (SIC 6000-6999) and utilities (SIC 4900-4999) sectors, with transaction values greater than $10 million; technology-peer candidates drawn from Compustat-CRSP listed firms with USPTO patent data (Kogan et al. 2017)
context.sample_size: 1,257 acquisition targets (peer portfolios) in the main CAAR analysis; 1,307 targets with patent data

Thomson SDC Platinum mergers and acquisitions (M&A) database
Bureau of Economic Analysis (input-output matrix / Customer Input Coefficient)
Hostile Takeover Index from Prof. Stephen McKeon's website (Cain et al. 2017)
Prof. Kenneth French's website (Fama-French 48 industry definitions)
